description: Lists the 3D model and image formats this connector converts, and which pairs are available. It converts 3D models, and images to images. It does not convert an image to a 3D model. formats gives each id a category of 3d or image. STEP (.step and .stp) is an input and is not an output. SKP, IGES, 3DM, DXF, other CAD, documents, video, and ABC as an input stay excluded. An uploaded file can be up to 50 MB. A file given as a URL can be up to 100 MB; the conversion API enforces that.

from.description: Optional input format. When set, pairs lists only that format's targets.

name: list_formats
title: List formats
